mapper.sql: SELECT s.work_id, s.work_type, w.title, i.resource_url AS cover_url, i.alt_text AS cover_alt, a.episode_count, s.favorite, s.wishlist, s.watch_status, s.watched_episodes FROM fl_saved_work s JOIN fl_work w ON w.id = s.work_id LEFT JOIN fl_anime a ON a.work_id = s.work_id LEFT JOIN fl_work_image i ON i.work_id = s.work_id AND i.image_kind = 'COVER' AND i.sort_order = 0 WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND w.is_listed = 1
mapper.select: ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.work_id DESC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO fl_saved_work target USING ( SELECT #{userId} AS user_id, #{item.workId} AS work_id FROM dual ) key_row ON (target.user_id = key_row.user_id AND target.work_id = key_row.work_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET favorite = #{item.favorite}, wishlist = #{item.wishlist}, watch_status = #{item.watchStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, watched_episodes = #{item.watchedEpisodes}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id, work_id, work_type, favorite, wishlist, watch_status, watched_episodes) VALUES (key_row.user_id, key_row.work_id, #{item.workType}, #{item.favorite}, #{item.wishlist}, #{item.watchStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.watchedEpisodes})
